conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Line numbers were read at HEAD 5add966 (2026-11-01, the commit that closed run 2026-10-28-app's batch b3). The source notes (.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-28-app/verify-b3-r3-A.md, verify-b2-r2-D.md, verify-b3-r1-B.md, verify-b3-r2-B.md, verify-b3-r1-C.md) were written against the same code before that commit, so a line they give may be a few lines off: search for the code a line points at. Packages run in waves: those that share no file run side by side, each in its own worktree (the ARB catalogs, lib/l10n/generated/ and test files don't count as shared). P314, P315 and P316 share no file. P317 shares App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart with P314, runs after it, and builds on what P314 left.

Copy is exact, shown as ES, EN and CA. EN copy sits between “ ”; ES and CA sit between « ». Keep the catalogs' marks: “…” and ’ in English; «…» in Spanish and Catalan; ’ in Catalan; … as one character (U+2026). Only P315 changes a string (ES `fileRemoveHelp`); no other package adds or changes copy. Run flutter gen-l10n after an ARB change; never edit lib/l10n/generated/. The ARB catalogs merge key by key between packages: change only your key, and don't reorder or reformat others.

Owner decisions bind every package (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md, every entry): the policy of 2026-10-13 (fix everything but product decisions; scoped runs go straight to fixing); D12 (Back on the form saves; a new task with no title just closes); D3's capture flow (one sheet; listening ends only on Listo); the free tier (the form for free accounts; 10 dictations a month; the used-up notice); UX-2110's rule as P292, P308 and P313 built it (one tap, one sheet or form; an entry is taken only by an empty sheet of its own mode, a blank entry form or an entry's used-up notice; shares always open their own; a notice is never closed; what holds something is never closed); D2 of 2026-10-31 (later) (each completion keeps its time and Completadas lists newest first; P300, P310). Still open, so no package changes them: U13 and what follows from it (UX-331, U10), and UX-615 (the confirming tap stays).
Backend/ is out of scope. No package changes what is stored, sent or shared: P315 passes a completion time the phone already holds to the same call P310 uses.

The speed bar holds: a plain one-task dictation stays Añadir tarea → speak → Listo → one confirming tap («Añadir al calendario»), and looks and saves as today. The test 'a plain single-task dictation looks and saves exactly as before, with no new tap' (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart) keeps passing. Judge every screen as a first-time, non-technical user would, in Spanish, often at large text: the owner's father.
Subtract first. No new settings, screens, tabs or concepts, and no copy beyond P315's one ES string.

Out of scope: another session's uncommitted work, .claude/ux-web/, Backend/, App/pubspec.yaml, App/scripts/, App/config/, the root build/ and scripts/ folders, and the plugin registrant files under App/linux, App/macos and App/windows that `flutter pub get` modifies. Don't edit, format or stage any of them.

Tests: the implementer keeps the suite passing, runs the tests of the files it touched in one call, and updates only the tests its change rightly breaks (say which in your notes). ux-tester writes the acceptance tests afterwards and reads copy through the generated AppLocalizations. Put a package's new tests in a group named for it (for example `group('P314 · …', …)`) at the end of the file's main(): test files merge between packages line by line. Harnesses this run uses: App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart (Pro sheets; the P313 group's `openOnline`, `speak` and `leaveAndComeBack`), App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart (free accounts' forms; `_FreeApp.open`, `entry`, `forms`, `usedUp`, `formTitle`), App/test/calendar_feedback_test.dart (Completadas and completion times; the P300 and P310 groups), App/test/attachment_panel_test.dart (the remove-file dialog; P293's `pumpPanel`), App/test/project_scope_control_test.dart (the picker sheets; UX-2514's tests), App/test/new_task_form_test.dart (the form at 2× with a keyboard; P304's group), App/test/task_detail_test.dart (the task page).

Sizes: 2× means TextScaler.linear(2.0); 360×800 and 360×740 are views at devicePixelRatio 1. Tests that measure a fit load Manrope, as new_task_form_test.dart and calendar_feedback_test.dart do. The preview suite scales linearly, while Android 14+ scales non-linearly: a label that wraps only at linear 2× isn't a failure on a phone.

Renders: from App/, `flutter test --no-pub --dart-define=WRITE_UX_PREVIEWS=true test/ux_previews/ux_previews_test.dart --plain-name "form/"` (or tasks/, sharing/) refreshes those PNGs with INDEX.md and AUDIT.md. Environment: a Linux cloud container with no Android SDK, emulator or phone. No agent touches a device, runs the backend or calls the AI. packages.title: From outside the app: a tap closes only a form that's as it opened, and lands in the paused sheet a close uncovers
brief: Round 4 of the widget and shortcut entry rules, after P292, P308 and P313 of run 2026-10-28-app (UX-2110, UX-2637, UX-2641 and UX-2642 are verified at widget level). Its two regressions from P313 (R3A-1 and R3A-2 in .claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-28-app/verify-b3-r3-A.md) sit in the same check in `_openEntries` (App/lib/main.dart:190-221), so they go together. Keep everything those packages built: `_entrySheets` (main.dart:95, :252-266, :467); `CaptureMode`, `emptyCaptureSheetOnTop` and `emptyCaptureSheetOnTopRecorded` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:205-231) and `_CaptureSheetRoute`'s `_empty`, `_typing` and `_recorded`; `captureOpensForm` (voice_task_screen.dart:161-163); `NewTaskArguments.blank` (App/lib/screens/edit_task_screen.dart:110-117); `NewTaskRoute` and its `empty` (:120-144); `emptyEntryFormOnTop` (:146-162), whose only caller stays `emptyTaskFormOnTop` (App/lib/widgets/task_form_entry.dart:90-110); `_notices`. Shares always open their own (`if (!shared)`), a notice is never closed, and `openTaskForm` still returns at once for its in-app callers. No copy, no ARB, no Kotlin; voice_task_screen.dart and task_form_entry.dart don't change.

UX-2643 (S2), what P313 did and why it fails: an entry that a blank form doesn't take pops it when `emptyEntryFormOnTop(navigator) != null` (main.dart:209, :220), and that test is the title alone (`NewTaskRoute.empty`, set by TaskEditor's `_markEmpty`, App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart:335-336). A blank form is an entry's own or the in-app «Nueva tarea» with no day, project or person. With no title but a picked day or time, a reminder, a repeat, steps, files or a project, it is closed by a VOICE entry (with dictations left; or at 0 left onto a TEXT entry's form), and all of that is lost unasked; notes survive under «Sin guardar», out of view. Before P313 an entry never closed a form, and P313's own rule is that an entry never closes what holds something.

UX-2643, the fix, settled here. Closing and absorbing keep two tests, as for sheets (UX-2641): absorbing shows the form as it is and loses nothing, so it keeps the title-only test (`emptyEntryFormOnTop` and `emptyTaskFormOnTop`, unchanged); closing needs a form that is as it opened. (a) Give `NewTaskRoute` a second flag next to `empty`, for example `bool untouched = true;`, documented as: nothing in its form changed since it opened, and Más detalles is closed; only such a blank form closes for an entry it doesn't take (UX-2643); the form keeps it from its first build on, until then it is. (b) In `_TaskEditorState`, set it with the editor's own comparison, the one `_save` uses (task_editor.dart:586): `_route?.untouched = !_detailsExpanded && !_pickingFile && const DeepCollectionEquality().equals(_edited().toMap(), _unchanged);`, for example inside `_markEmpty` (rename it if that reads better, and keep its doc true). Keep it current on every change: call it at the start of `build` (every setState in the form rebuilds it: the day and time chips, reminder, repeat, steps, files, project, Más detalles), keep the `_title` listener (:317), and add the same listener on `_notes` (typing notes doesn't rebuild the form). Why Más detalles and the file pick count: a step typed without Enter waits in ChecklistEditor's own field (App/lib/widgets/checklist_editor.dart:29, :55-77) until focus leaves, and a file pick runs outside the form; neither is in `_edited()` yet, and in a new task's form both are reached only with Más detalles open (task_editor.dart:1097-1115). (c) In edit_task_screen.dart, next to `emptyEntryFormOnTop`, add for example `bool untouchedEntryFormOnTop(NavigatorState navigator)`: true when the current `NewTaskRoute` on [navigator] was opened `blank` and is both `empty` and `untouched` (the same loop as :151-162), documented with UX-2643. (d) In `_openEntries`, close a form only when `untouchedEntryFormOnTop(navigator)` is true, in place of `form != null` (:220). Otherwise the entry opens its own sheet or form over the form, as over an in-app one, and Cancelar or Back shows the form with what it held.

UX-2643, a caution: if a value nobody set changes after the form opens, the form never counts as untouched, and P313's one-form tests fail. One candidate is `_responsibility` (task_editor.dart:85-103), which derives the assignment from the project list; that list may still be loading at open when Calendar is scoped to a shared project. If you meet such a field, compare the fields the person sets instead of the whole map (title, notes, day, time, deadline, duration, reminder, plan, repeat, priority, steps, files, project and person), and say so in your notes.

UX-2644 (S1), what P313 did and why it fails: the checks run once, before the pop (main.dart:204-220), and never look at what the pop uncovers. Pro, online listening: (1) the widget's mic records and the app is left, so a voice sheet keeping a recording waits, paused; it is empty (no words, no result) and `_recorded`. (2) A TEXT entry opens a typing sheet over it, as P313 means. (3) A second VOICE entry pops the empty typing sheet, which uncovers the paused voice sheet; that sheet would take a VOICE entry (`sheet == asked`), but the entry still opens a second voice sheet, with a second recorder, over it. Nothing is lost (Cancelar on the new one shows the paused one), but two voice sheets stack, UX-2110's pattern.

UX-2644, the fix, settled here: after the close-first pop, ask the absorbing question once more, and if what the pop uncovered takes the entry, acknowledge it and open nothing. Write the absorbing test once, as a local function in the `if (!shared)` block, for example `bool takes() => (_entrySheets > 0 ? emptyCaptureSheetOnTop(navigator) : null) == asked || (captureOpensForm(ProviderScope.containerOf(context, listen: false), typing: !voice) && emptyTaskFormOnTop(navigator, askedToSpeak: voice));`. Use it before the pop as today (`if (takes()) { await entries.acknowledge(entry.id); continue; }`), and again right after `navigator.pop()`. Pop at most once per entry, and only what the rules close: an empty sheet of the other mode with no recording, or an untouched blank form. `navigator.pop()` makes the route under it current at once (`isCurrent`), so nothing needs waiting for. `_entrySheets` still counts the popped sheet until its future completes; that can only let the re-check absorb, never close anything. Keep the comment above the block (:190-201) true: name UX-2643 (a form closes only as it opened) and UX-2644 (what a close uncovers may take the entry).

Tests (ux-tester writes the acceptance tests): the Pro sheet case in a group 'P314 · an entry closes only what is as it opened' at the end of main() in App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart, reusing the P313 group's `openOnline`, `speak` and `leaveAndComeBack` (:4159-4212; lift them out of that group if needed, without changing them). The free-account form cases in a group of the same name at the end of main() in App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart, with `_FreeApp.open`, `entry(...)`, `forms()`, `usedUp()`, `formTitle` and the day chips' keys `new-task-today`, `new-task-tomorrow` and `new-task-pick-day`, as P313's group uses them (:3994-4253). P313's cases where nothing is touched are the untouched case and must pass unchanged. The real widget and shortcuts aren't reachable here; the device checks say what the emulator should check.
acceptance: UX-2643: free account with 5 dictations left, ES 1× on 360×800. A TEXT entry opens the form; tap «Mañana» (`new-task-tomorrow`) and type no title. A VOICE entry opens the listening sheet over the form, with one TaskEditor still under it. Cancelar shows the form with «Mañana» chosen and its title empty; nothing is saved.

UX-2643: free account with 0 dictations left, the used-up notice already seen. A TEXT entry opens the form; tap «Mañana», no title. A VOICE entry opens a second form on top, with the used-up line (`free-voice-used-up`) and no day chosen. Back on it shows the first form with «Mañana» chosen.

UX-2643: free account with 5 left. A TEXT entry's form, no title: open «Más detalles», add a step «Comprar pan» (typed, then Enter), then close «Más detalles» (the step still shows). A VOICE entry opens the listening sheet over it; Cancelar shows the form with its step «Comprar pan».

UX-2643: free account with 5 left. A TEXT entry's form with only «Más detalles» opened, nothing typed or picked. A VOICE entry opens the listening sheet over it (an open Más detalles counts as started); Cancelar shows the form.
UX-2643, absorbing unchanged: free account with 0 left, a TEXT entry's form with «Mañana» picked and no title, then a TEXT entry: still exactly one form, with «Mañana» chosen.

P313's untouched cases still hold. At 0 left, TEXT then VOICE with nothing touched: exactly one form, with the used-up line; Back lands on Calendar. With dictations left, TEXT then VOICE with nothing touched: the listening sheet with no form under it; Cancelar lands on Calendar.

UX-2644: Pro, ES 1× on 360×800, online listening (the phone's recognizer fails to start). A VOICE entry, words spoken (the recording kept), the app left and resumed: paused, «Grabación conservada en este teléfono». A TEXT entry opens a typing sheet over it. Then a VOICE entry leaves exactly one capture sheet: the paused voice sheet, with «Grabación conservada en este teléfono» showing and hit-testable. There is one recorder, started once; all three entries are acknowledged; the capture keeps its `audioPath` and isn't discarded.

P308's and P313's sheet cases still pass. Pro, native listening, nothing heard: VOICE then TEXT 300 ms later leaves one capture sheet, typing; TEXT then VOICE leaves one sheet, listening. Online listening with audio kept: two VOICE entries 300 ms apart leave one sheet, still listening, and a TEXT entry opens a typing sheet over the recorded one.
deviceChecks: TaskFlow_Review emulator, free account with dictations left: open «Escribir una tarea» from the launcher shortcut, tap «Mañana» without a title, go Home, then tap the widget's mic. The listening sheet opens over the form; Cancelar shows the form with «Mañana» still chosen.
Emulator, free account with 0 dictations left: the shortcut's form, «Mañana», Home, then the widget's mic. A second form opens, saying no dictations are left; Back shows the first form with «Mañana».

One sheet shows: the paused one, with «Grabación conservada en este teléfono». Cancelar asks whether to keep or discard.

packages.title: The task page: Completar keeps Completadas' time, and the remove-file help says «Se quitará»
brief: Two small things on a task's page. Neither changes what is stored or sent.

UX-2646 (S1), what happens: Completadas («Tareas completadas», App/lib/screens/completed_tasks_screen.dart) remembers each row's completion time in `_doneHere` (:35-42, :104). It gives that time back when a row reopened there is ticked again with its own checkbox (P310, UX-2638): `TaskList` passes `doneAt` (App/lib/widgets/task_list.dart:88), `TaskTile` hands it to its `toggle` (App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart:212-218), then `TaskInteractions.toggle(doneAt:)` → `setCompleted(at:)`. But a row opened from Completadas and ticked on its own page goes through `TaskDetailScreen._toggle` (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:62-86), which calls `TaskInteractions.toggle(context, ref, task)` with no `doneAt` (:71). So the task is stamped now and listed first on the next visit. Covering Completadas also clears `_doneHere` (completed_tasks_screen.dart:66-67), so the page has to carry the time itself. Source: verify-b3-r2-B.md (run 2026-10-28-app), whose suggested fix is that the detail page could take the remembered time from Completadas.

UX-2646, the fix, settled here: (a) `TaskDetailScreen` gets an optional `final DateTime? doneAt;` (constructor :23-35), documented as the time Completadas remembers for the row the page was opened from: Completar gives it back rather than stamping now (UX-2646). (b) `_toggle`'s tick (:71) passes `doneAt: widget.doneAt`. The reopen path (:63-66) stays as it is; `TaskInteractions.toggle` ignores `doneAt` on a reopen. (c) `TaskTile`'s `open()` (:200-210) passes `doneAt: doneAt`; update the field's doc (:51-53): the time a row on Completadas was done at, given back when it is ticked again, on the row or on its page. (d) `TaskList` (:88) passes `doneAt: timeOf?.call(task)` for every row, done or open, so a done row's page has the time too, and «Reabrir» then «Completar» on that page keeps the row's place as well. The row's own checkbox doesn't change: a reopen ignores `doneAt`. Every other way to a task's page passes nothing and still stamps now, as their rows do (P310's test 'UX-2638: ticking an open task on Calendar, or on Tareas, at 12:00 still stores 12:00'): Calendar, Tareas, project pages, Sin fecha, notifications, Novedades and the timeline. A completion from before schema 21 has no time and is still stamped now, as P310 accepted.

UX-2645 (S1): the remove-file dialog (App/lib/widgets/attachment_panel.dart:135-156) asks «¿Quitar este archivo de la tarea?» with «Quitar archivo» (UX-2418, P293), but its help line, ES `fileRemoveHelp` (App/lib/l10n/app_es.arb:407), still opens with «Se eliminará de la tarea…», the word UX-2418 took out. Change only the ES value, to: «Se quitará de la tarea y, si lo has subido, de tus otros dispositivos al sincronizar. Tu archivo original no se elimina.» «Eliminar» then stays only for the original file, which really isn't deleted. EN (“This removes it from the task and, if uploaded, your other devices when they sync. Your original file is not deleted.”) and CA («Es traurà de la tasca i, si s’ha pujat, dels altres dispositius quan se sincronitzin. El fitxer original no se suprimirà.») already say remove and stay unchanged. Run flutter gen-l10n. P293's test (App/test/attachment_panel_test.dart:880-935) reads the help through `l.fileRemoveHelp` and keeps passing. The `tasks/detail.remove-file` preview's description stays true; re-render tasks/.

Tests (ux-tester): UX-2646 in a group 'P315 · the task page' at the end of main() in App/test/calendar_feedback_test.dart, next to P300's and P310's groups (:4934, :5220), with their clock and Completadas set-up. UX-2645 in a group of the same name at the end of main() in App/test/attachment_panel_test.dart, reusing P293's `pumpPanel`.
acceptance: UX-2646: «Tareas completadas», ES 1× on 360×800, three tasks ticked at 09:00, 10:00 and 11:00 (listed 11:00, 10:00, 09:00). Reopen the 10:00 row with its checkbox, tap the row to open its page, and tap «Completar» at 12:00. The page closes; the task's stored completion time is 10:00; Completadas lists 11:00, 10:00, 09:00, on this visit and on the next.

UX-2646: the same three tasks. Open the 10:00 row's page while it is done, tap «Reabrir» (the page stays), then «Completar» at 12:00. Its stored time is 10:00, and the next visit lists 11:00, 10:00, 09:00.

UX-2646: a repeating task's repetition done at 10:00, between rows done at 09:00 and 11:00, reopened on Completadas and ticked on its page at 12:00: its time for that date stays 10:00, and it keeps its place on the next visit.
A task's page opened from Calendar or from Tareas: «Completar» at 12:00 still stores 12:00.

UX-2645: in ES, the remove-file dialog on a task's page shows «¿Quitar este archivo de la tarea?», the file's name, then «Se quitará de la tarea y, si lo has subido, de tus otros dispositivos al sincronizar. Tu archivo original no se elimina.», with «Quitar archivo». Nothing in the dialog says «Se eliminará». The EN and CA help lines are unchanged.
deviceChecks: TaskFlow_Review emulator with the local API at migration 0026: on «Tareas completadas», reopen a row that isn't the newest, tap it, then tap «Completar». Back on the list it sits where it was; leave and come back, and it is still there. After a sync, the server's `completed_at` for it is still the first completion's time.

packages.title: «¿Quién es responsable?» and «Novedades del proyecto» open with a heading
brief: UX-2647 (S1): two picker sheets open with their title as a plain row, while the project sheet (App/lib/widgets/task_list_picker.dart:59-68) and the role sheet (`_chooseRole`, App/lib/screens/groups_screen.dart:522-530) open with a heading (UX-2514, P294). «¿Quién es responsable?» is a `ListTile` (App/lib/widgets/task_assignment_picker.dart:148-150), which TalkBack reads as a plain item in a 56 dp row. «Novedades del proyecto» is a `ListTile` with the project's name as its subtitle (App/lib/widgets/project_preferences.dart:22-25). Source: verify-b3-r1-C.md (run 2026-10-28-app), its note that the other two pickers' titles are still plain rows, not headings.

The fix, as the project sheet does it, with no copy (the strings stay): (a) In task_assignment_picker.dart, replace that ListTile, the ListView's first child, with `Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 0, 24, 8), child: Semantics(header: true, child: Text(context.l10n.assignmentChoose, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium)))`. Keep the drag handle, `isScrollControlled` and the 70% cap (:135-145), the rows, the ✓ (UX-2514) and what a tap returns. (b) In project_preferences.dart, replace the title ListTile with the same heading, with `projectNotifications`, and under it, in the same padding, the project's name (`project.name`) as a plain line in `bodyMedium` with `onSurfaceVariant`, outside the heading's Semantics, so TalkBack reads the heading, then the name. Give the Column `crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch`, as `_chooseRole` does (groups_screen.dart:519), so the heading starts at the 24 dp edge instead of centring. Keep the drag handle, the three choices, their icons and the ✓.

«Novedades del proyecto» isn't scroll-controlled, so it is capped at 9/16 of the screen. The heading is shorter than the row it replaces, so the sheet only gets shorter; still, at ES and CA 2× on 360×740 all three choices must show whole. If the last one doesn't, make the sheet scroll-controlled with the same cap and scroll as «¿Quién es responsable?» (`isScrollControlled: true`, and a `ConstrainedBox(maxHeight: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * .7)` around a shrink-wrapped ListView), as UX-2639 did for the project sheet.

No preview opens either sheet. Add one state for each, at es1 and ca2: `tasks/detail.responsible-sheet` in App/test/ux_previews/tasks_previews.dart, set up as `detail.created-by` (:561-574), then tap the task's person chip «Ana» to open «¿Quién es responsable?» (if that account can't change it, use another detail state where it can); and `sharing/project-sharing.updates-sheet` in App/test/ux_previews/sharing_previews.dart, set up as `project-sharing.owner` (:174-191), then scroll to «Novedades del proyecto» and tap it. Describe each as it shows. Tests (ux-tester): a group 'P316 · picker headings' at the end of main() in App/test/project_scope_control_test.dart, next to UX-2514's tests that open both sheets (:591, :635).
acceptance: UX-2647: «¿Quién es responsable?», opened from a task in a shared project with two editors (ES 1× on 360×800): «¿Quién es responsable?» is a heading (its semantics node has the header flag), in titleMedium, starting 24 dp from the sheet's left edge, and isn't a ListTile. «Todos» and each person follow, and only the chosen row has a ✓ (UX-2514's tests still pass).

UX-2647: «Novedades del proyecto», opened for «Casa» (ES 1× on 360×800): «Novedades del proyecto» is a heading in titleMedium, starting 24 dp from the sheet's left edge; «Casa» is a plain line under it, outside the heading's node; then «Todos los cambios», «Solo lo que es para mí» and «Silenciado: sin novedades ni recordatorios», the chosen one with its ✓.

At ES and CA 2× on 360×740, each sheet shows its heading whole. «Novedades del proyecto»'s last choice («Silenciado: sin novedades ni recordatorios» / «Silenciat: sense novetats ni recordatoris») shows whole above the sheet's bottom edge, and in «¿Quién es responsable?» the last person can be scrolled into view.
TalkBack order in both sheets: the heading, then (in «Novedades del proyecto») the project's name, then the choices.
deviceChecks: TaskFlow_Review emulator with TalkBack on: open «¿Quién es responsable?» from a shared project's task, then «Novedades del proyecto» from «Compartir proyecto». TalkBack reads each title as a heading («encabezado»), and moving by headings lands on it.

packages.title: Wrapped labels centre beside their icon: the form's add button and the task page's reminder chip
brief: Two labels that wrap at large text sit left, with their icon stranded at the edge: the class UX-2608 and UX-2630 fixed for buttons (P289, P304: `textAlign: TextAlign.center` with `textWidthBasis: TextWidthBasis.longestLine`; App/lib/screens/subscription_screen.dart:314-318, data_transfer_screen.dart:200-208, device_calendars_screen.dart:113-115). Both were noted in verify-b2-r2-D.md, note 3 (run 2026-10-28-app). This package runs after P314, which also changes App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart: find the code by searching, and keep what P314 left. No copy.
